title: Pina Colada

options.name: Full
options.text: Add 80ml rum and 160ml pineapple juice to the shaker.

options.name: Almost full
options.text: Add 60ml rum and 180ml pineapple juice to the shaker.

options.name: Half to almost full
options.text: Add 50ml rum and 190ml pineapple juice to the shaker.

options.name: Half
options.text: Add 40ml rum and 200ml pineapple juice to the shaker.

instructions: Add 40ml of heavy cream and 20ml of syrup.
Split into two cups and serve over some ice.
